name: openbb-terminal

OPENBB_PAT.description: OpenBB Hub personal access token. Required only when using credentialed data providers (FMP, Polygon, Benzinga, etc.) configured at openbb.co.

OPENBB_PROVIDER_PREFERENCES.description: JSON map of asset class to preferred provider, e.g. {"equity": "fmp", "crypto": "binance"}. Defaults to OpenBB's free-tier providers.

EXPORT_DIR.description: Directory to write exported tables / charts into. Defaults to ./output.

notes: Wraps the OpenBB Platform Python SDK — read-only access to equities, options, crypto, macro, and news data via OpenBB's provider abstraction. ADVISOR tier — outputs are previewed before write-out (data fetches can hit per-provider rate limits and quotas). Trust floor is moderate because the surface is read-only but provider credentials may carry billing weight. License is custom (AGPL-3.0 for OpenBB Terminal CLI; the Platform SDK is MIT) — review the LICENSE file in your installed version.
